title: RNAseq to profile IFNg response in human primary monocytes
description: We did transcriptome profiling for monocytes treated with or without IFNg to characterize IFNg response. Overall design: Human primary monocytes were cultured for 24 hours with or without IFNg, harversted and prepared for RNA for RNAseq.

attributes: human primary monocytes isolated from PBMC of healthy donors
